git._comment: github_repo = product repo (owner/name); agents_github_repo = this agent home's repo. Branch prefixes and pr_footer control how agent work is labelled on GitHub.

layout._comment: Filled by the Architect in phase 1. Top-level folders of the product repo; agents never create files outside them (root_files excepted).

_contracts_comment: Product-repo folder the contracts are published to (inside a layout folder, e.g. api/contracts). Source of truth: contracts/ in this agent home.

team._comment: Filled by the Architect in session 0. github = handle without @. Owners in chunks.json refer to these handles.

checks._comment: Filled by the Architect once the stack is chosen. gate.sh runs these from the product repo root (or a fresh worktree) in this order; setup must make a fresh worktree runnable (install deps from lockfiles).

design._comment: Filled in phase 1-2 once the design system is frozen (artifacts/ui/design-system.md). ui_paths = product globs with UI code; theme_paths = files allowed to hold raw colour values (theme, tokens). gate.sh's 'design' check flags colour literals in agent-built UI files outside theme_paths. screenshots = command that renders every screen (and the prototypes) to PNGs in $SCREENSHOT_DIR; used by ui-polish and reviewer-ui.

deploy._comment: Filled by the Architect. Deploys happen from main only.

network._comment: Extra sandbox domains approved by the user (allow-domain.sh).
